decisions.statement: A long message from an agent annoys Alan.
Alan does not read a long message.
An agent that asks Alan for more than one thing annoys Alan.
An agent that says the agent will act and then does not annoys Alan.
An agent that says the agent is acting while not acting annoys Alan.
An agent that stops before the work is done for no good reason annoys Alan.
An agent that asks whether Alan wants to stop while work remains annoys Alan.
An agent that waits for a file to be free instead of starting work annoys Alan.
An agent that uses the word "stands" annoys Alan.
Answering Alan is reason enough to stop.
Asking Alan is reason enough to stop.

definition: what an agent does that annoys Alan
